name: obsidian-circle
description: Obsidian Circle (OC) — Connect. Create. Go Live.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm start -w apps/api" "npm start -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
